disambiguation: It is a local file synchronization tool, not a cloud-based Kindle integration.
extras: Highlights and vault content remain local; no cloud sync, telemetry, Amazon, or Readwise connection.
problem: Users want to keep Kindle highlights and notes organized within their Obsidian vault without uploading reading data to external services.

requires.name: Kindle with local My Clippings.txt file

summary: A desktop-only plugin that reads local My Clippings.txt files from Kindle and converts highlights into organized Markdown notes within the vault.
